metadata.description: Skills for Claude: study flashcard decks, and a checked document humanizer

plugins.name: flashcard-deck
plugins.description: Turn any subject, or material you already have (PDFs, slides, notes, a repo, Anki cards), into print-friendly A4 study flashcards grouped by topic, with PDFs, and optionally YouTube videos and thumbnails.

plugins.name: humanize-document
plugins.description: Bring a Word, Markdown or text document under a target AI score (50% by default) in the JustDone detector by rewriting its most-flagged paragraphs in Grubby, with Claude checking every rewrite for meaning. Needs paid Grubby and JustDone subscriptions and Claude in Chrome.
